newsitem.title: UK: CSFB, DMG have mandate for Romania's bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: CSFB, DMG have mandate for Romania's bond - dealers.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell were said to have won the mandate to lead manage Romania's first mark Eurobond, syndicate officials said on Friday.
"Any deal would still be a long way off, at least four weeks. So the amount and maturity would be subject to market conditions," a syndicate manager said.

CSFB and DMG said they could not comment on the mandate. Romania has said it plans to raise around 500 million marks on the international bond market. Some said the amount could be for up to 750 million marks at a five or seven-year maturity.
Russia's recent mark bond is the benchmark in the sector.
Russia launched a 2.0 billion mark seven-year bond in mid-March via joint lead managers CSFB and DMG. The deal was trading at 370 basis points over Bunds, its reoffer level.
The National Bank of Romania launched its debut Eurobond -- a well-received $225 million three-year Eurobond -- last June via Merrill Lynch.
Romania is rated Ba3 by Moody's Investors Service and BB- by Standard and Poor's Corp, both just below investment grade.
